question: I want code examples to float on the side and stay visible as users scroll through long explanations. Can I put any type of content in this floating section? Will it adapt properly to mobile screens?
ground_truth: You can use the `<Aside>` component to create a sticky container that floats content to the right side of your page and remains visible as users scroll. The component is flexible - you can wrap any supplementary content inside it, including API snippets using `<EndpointRequestSnippet>`, code blocks, response examples, or any other content that should stay visible during scroll. For example: `<Aside><EndpointRequestSnippet endpoint='POST /chat/{{domain}}' /></Aside>`. The `<Aside>` component automatically handles positioning and layout, including responsive behavior for different screen sizes, so you don't need to worry about layout conflicts on mobile or smaller viewports - it will adapt appropriately to maintain a good user experience across devices.

metadata.cited_context: The `<Aside>` component creates a sticky container that floats content to the right of your page. Use it to showcase code examples, API snippets, or any supplementary content that should stay visible as users scroll.
